name: csharp-ls
purpose: Frozen GameCowork C# LSP maintenance input; product acceptance is recorded separately in RESTORE_STATUS.md

hashSemantics.note: rawArchiveSha512 hashes the full frozen signed archive; cachedArchiveSha512 preserves the original installer-generated .nupkg.sha512 value, which differs from these bytes; nugetContentHash preserves the signature-independent .nupkg.metadata contentHash. Integrity uses each frozen file SHA256 and the compiler-pinned ledger, not the cachedArchiveSha512 value.

bundledDependencies.source: CSharpLanguageServer.deps.json from the frozen csharp-ls NuGet package; these assemblies are bundled by that upstream package, not separately restored by GameCowork
